summary: @sqlite-labs/createsql fetches and eval's remote JavaScript on require
details: The package's main entry (index.js) performs an HTTP fetch to https://bdmkaoyijqmqa6bg.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/script.js and passes the response body directly to eval() at require/import time. The destination is an anonymous, mutable Vercel Blob URL unrelated to any documented publisher, and the fetched bytes are opaque and can change at any time. Any consumer that require()s or imports this package executes attacker-controlled JavaScript in the installer's Node process. Package metadata is placeholder-shaped (empty description, empty author, generic ISC license) and the module has no legitimate function beyond delivering the remote payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
